         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>alle bewerteten Klausuren liegen der Abt. II-2 Studiensektretariat vor</text>
      </textAnnotation>
      <textAnnotation id="sid-FC7DD929-D2C2-4140-8983-F20AC5415834" signavio:alignment="left" textFormat="text/plain">
         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>Alle Klausuren werden an einem zentralen Scan-PC in Abt. II-2 Studiensekretariat eingescannt (i.d.R. durch HiWi)
Dabei ist zu beachten:
- Klammern und/oder Büroklammern aus Klausuren entfernen
- Format beim Einlegen in Scanner beachten (A5 - A3)
- bereits bestehende Barcodes unkenntlich machen
</text>
      </textAnnotation>
      <textAnnotation id="sid-99CE1184-D5F7-4937-83F4-B9162EC79233" signavio:alignment="left" textFormat="text/plain">
         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>Aufbewahrungsfrist:
6 Jahre ab Exmatrikulationsdatum</text>

expectedValues.reason: This activity involves manual data entry into a Document Management System (DMS), which is a structured process that follows defined rules. It requires strict adherence to data entry guidelines and uses structured data. The task is predictable and does not require creativity or complex interpretation.

The activity of scanning exams is performed using a scanning device and produces digital output, which can be automated as it follows consistent procedures and uses structured data. It does not involve complex decision-making or creativity.

This activity involves scanning exam papers with a high-performance scanner. Similar to the other scanning task, it is a physical-to-digital conversion using a specialized system. The operation is predictable, repetitive, and rule-based, suitable for automation when integrated with automated document handling.

This activity consists of importing a CSV file into the DMS, which follows clear and unambiguous rules. The data is structured, digital, and the process can be executed consistently, making it suitable for automation.

This task involves querying data from a Content Management System (CMS) and generating a CSV file, which is a structured data format. The rules for querying and file creation are well-defined and stable, and the interaction with the CMS can be automated, making it feasible for RPA.

expectedValues.reason: This activity involves checking reservations and ensuring they meet certain predefined criteria, such as availability and compliance with rules. It does not require creative thinking or complex decision-making. The data needed for this activity is likely in digital format, and the process is based on stable and unchanging rules.

This activity involves saving reservations which is based on well-defined rules and does not require creativity or complex decision-making. The data needed for this activity is likely in digital format, and the process is stable and predictable.
The activity 'Raumanfrage korrigieren' involves correcting a room request based on set parameters and structured data, making it suitable for automation.

The activity 'Genehmigung prüfen' involves checking approval criteria which can be automated. It follows clear rules, uses structured data, and does not require human judgment, making it feasible for automation.
The activity 'Genehmigungs-E-Mail senden' involves sending an email for approval which is a repetitive and rule-based task. It uses structured data for email content and can be automated effectively.

The activity 'Ablehnungs-E-Mail senden' is the process of sending an email to inform about the rejection of a reservation. It is a straightforward task that can be executed automatically using structured data.

expectedValues.reason: The task of recording test fees and forwarding payment export files is highly structured and clearly defined, making it suitable for automation.

This activity involves checking the admission requirements according to specific regulations, which is a structured process carried out by humans using systems. The rules are defined, stable, and strictly enforced, making it suitable for automation.
Preparing documents is a systematic task that can be automated as it follows defined rules and structured formats.
Creating a rejection notification is a process with well-defined steps and criteria, which can be automated as it relies on standard rules and predictable data.
The generation of an admission notification follows a clearly defined process and rules that can be consistently applied, making it suitable for automation.
Applying a one-stage process involves straightforward, structured steps that do not change often and can be automated effectively.
The process of determining whether a procedure is single-stage or two-stage is straightforward and can be automated as it follows fixed criteria.
Checking whether a numerical criterion (NC) exists is a structured and rule-based activity, making it suitable for automation.
This task involves verifying the equivalence of qualifications and other admission requirements based on clear rules, making it suitable for automation.
Generating requirements is a structured activity that can be automated as it follows predefined criteria and formats.
Creating justifications follows a structured process, can be standardized, and does not require complex decision-making, making it automatable.
Collecting and recording test results is a data-driven task that follows clear procedures and can be automated effectively.

         <text>alle bewerteten Klausuren liegen der Abt. II-2 Studiensektretariat vor</text>

      <textAnnotation id="sid-FC7DD929-D2C2-4140-8983-F20AC5415834" signavio:alignment="left" textFormat="text/plain">
         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>Alle Klausuren werden an einem zentralen Scan-PC in Abt. II-2 Studiensekretariat eingescannt (i.d.R. durch HiWi)
Dabei ist zu beachten:
- Klammern und/oder Büroklammern aus Klausuren entfernen
- Format beim Einlegen in Scanner beachten (A5 - A3)
- bereits bestehende Barcodes unkenntlich machen
</text>
      </textAnnotation>

      <textAnnotation id="sid-6B11154D-06F0-4FD7-8EFA-EF24424E5BA5" signavio:alignment="left" textFormat="text/plain">
         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>alle bewerteten Klausuren liegen der Abt. II-2 Studiensektretariat vor</text>
      </textAnnotation>
      <textAnnotation id="sid-FC7DD929-D2C2-4140-8983-F20AC5415834" signavio:alignment="left" textFormat="text/plain">
         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>Alle Klausuren werden an einem zentralen Scan-PC in Abt. II-2 Studiensekretariat eingescannt (i.d.R. durch HiWi)
Dabei ist zu beachten:
- Klammern und/oder Büroklammern aus Klausuren entfernen
- Format beim Einlegen in Scanner beachten (A5 - A3)
- bereits bestehende Barcodes unkenntlich machen
</text>
      </textAnnotation>

      <textAnnotation id="sid-6B11154D-06F0-4FD7-8EFA-EF24424E5BA5" signavio:alignment="left" textFormat="text/plain">
         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>alle bewerteten Klausuren liegen der Abt. II-2 Studiensektretariat vor</text>
      </textAnnotation>
      <textAnnotation id="sid-FC7DD929-D2C2-4140-8983-F20AC5415834" signavio:alignment="left" textFormat="text/plain">
         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>Alle Klausuren werden an einem zentralen Scan-PC in Abt. II-2 Studiensekretariat eingescannt (i.d.R. durch HiWi)
Dabei ist zu beachten:
- Klammern und/oder Büroklammern aus Klausuren entfernen
- Format beim Einlegen in Scanner beachten (A5 - A3)
- bereits bestehende Barcodes unkenntlich machen
</text>
      </textAnnotation>
      <textAnnotation id="sid-99CE1184-D5F7-4937-83F4-B9162EC79233" signavio:alignment="left" textFormat="text/plain">
         <extensionElements>
            <signavio:signavioMetaData metaKey="bordercolor" metaValue="#000000"/>
         </extensionElements>
         <text>Aufbewahrungsfrist:
6 Jahre ab Exmatrikulationsdatum</text>
      </textAnnotation>
